module_summary: Open-aperture surface suite exposing signature, operators, drift surface, and lineage hooks for all Open* domains. Governed by three rings (Trust, Motion, Meaning) and a five-step operational loop.
author: Nawder Loswin

legacy.note: Prior suite root (openapi, 13-module OpenWarden architecture) is stamped legacy: true. Redirect active. All new operations use the six-module openloop suite.

files.description: Suite root index. Navigation hub with condensed drift event on first screen.
HTML front door for the openloop suite with canonical head block and fixed child links.
Developer-facing README. Contribution guide, operator grammar reference, setup, subfolder removal commands.
OpenLLM consolidated surface: architecture, canonical metadata, governance, operators, open loop, three rings, drift-event JSON, worked example.
OpenIAM consolidated surface: identity, access chain, principal registry, operators, open loop, three rings, worked example. Trust-ring anchor.
OpenRisk consolidated surface: risk tier definitions, severity formula, gate protocol, operators, open loop, three rings.
OpenGeo consolidated surface: geospatial and temporal grounding, coordinate anchors, location scope levels, operators, open loop.
OpenGPU consolidated surface: parallel execution substrate, execution modes, throughput regimes, gate protocol, operators.
OpenData consolidated surface: data surface, lineage registry, schema registry, lineage note schema, operators, lineage store structure. Terminal step of every open loop.
Per-module manifest listing all files, roles, and analyzer layers for this suite.
Cross-suite registry of all Open* modules with dimension vectors, coherence thresholds, and operator affinities.
Four-quadrant view of the suite mapped by primary ring and regime.
Suite navigation structure for site nav, AI agents, and sitemap generators.
XML sitemap for search engines and AI crawlers.
